name: Agents only propose
description: Approve, reject, hold and release happen only when a person presses the button in Review.

name: Offline
description: AI engines use a model on your own machine (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM); the built-in rules use no model. No cloud calls.

name: Uploads stay put
description: Uploaded files are read in memory and never used as file paths. Only your saved work is stored.

name: Quote check
description: Each quoted line is matched to the source file before it is shown.

name: Skeptic review
description: A second agent tries to disprove every finding. Always on, locked.

name: Audit trail
description: Every proposal, verdict and decision is logged with time and actor.
